name: On the Knife's Edge
source:
The year is 1990. 
Prototype racing's popularity is at its all time high, and manufacturers from all around the world rush to put their name on the map. When you're down in the gutter, an opportunity arises at an underdog team, in an unexpected place. You jump on it, not knowing what really comes next.
It takes more than just skill to rise to the top, and you know that damn well. Every deal, handshake, sponsor, and signature comes with it's own hidden agendas, pushing and pulling you one way or the other. As the real players continue to play their cards, the allure of racing slowly changes.
Do you still want to drive, or are you waiting for an excuse to stop pretending you do?

On the Knife's Edge is an FVN pertaining to the glamours and politics of motorsports. The story follows the main character, Viktor, a former Trans Am California driver who quit the sport after witnessing one of the most traumatic events a driver could ever see. 
Now placed with the burden of overcoming this new weight on his shoulders, a new opportunity presents itself. Will he take it?
